text:
sara_sec: quick sync: we've seen 3 suppressed DAST/SAST criticals in the last week where the CI run decrypted payloads but we can't find a KMS Decrypt audit line to prove it. this blocks safe auto-suppression. need a resilient evidence + RBAC plan.

tom_dev: confirmed one example: decrypt retry succeeded but Cloud Logging had no Decrypt protoPayload for the deploy-sa in that minute. CI logs show decrypt stdout but no logged KMS event.

sara_sec: proposal: 1) give security a read-only path to query decrypted-evidence without granting extra kms perms (export decrypt audit logs to BigQuery daily + grant security BigQuery read), 2) augment CI to upload a signed "evidence bundle" (encrypted with a team key) to internal artifacts on successful decrypt so security can inspect without re-decrypting, 3) add a pre-merge check that queries BigQuery for Decrypt events before allowing auto-suppress.

rachel_sre: steps sound good. for BigQuery export: we'll wire a sink from Cloud Logging -> BigQuery with partitioning on DATE(timestamp) to keep queries cheap. example sink create:```bash
gcloud logging sinks create audit-bq-sink bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/redwood-prod/datasets/audit_logs --log-filter='protoPayload.methodName="google.crypto.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"'```
we'll need owner to approve dataset IAM for security group.

dave_prodsec: from least-privilege POV prefer granting security access to the audit dataset rather than giving them cloudkms roles. the evidence-bundle approach is nice because it decouples access from KMS. how do we protect the bundle?

sara_sec: bundle format idea: create tar with CI stdout excerpt, commit sha, trace_id, and encrypted proof blob (ciphertext + KMS key metadata). sign the tar with the repo key and upload to internal artifact bucket with kms:encrypt-only using a dedicated prod-evidence-key that only security can decrypt. that way we don't change deploy SA perms.

tom_dev: small implementation note: add a structured log line before decrypt with trace_id so BigQuery query can join CI run -> Decrypt audit row. e.g. stdout: `{"trace_id":"${TRACE}" , "phase":"pre-decrypt"}` and instrument the sink to include protoPayload fields.

rachel_sre: runbook additions: when a SAST/DAST block occurs and evidence-bundle missing or no BigQuery Decrypt row: (A) escalate to sec oncall, (B) run `bq query --use_legacy_sql=false "SELECT * FROM audit_logs.decrypts WHERE trace_id='...' LIMIT 1"`, (C) if still missing, require manual approval and mark incident for timeline reconstruction.

infra-bot: [auto] created SEC-915: "audit export + evidence-bundle flow for suppressed SAST/DAST" assigned to @sara_sec, @rachel_sre. https://github.internal/redwood/security/SEC-915

dave_prodsec: two follow-ups: (1) retention: set BigQuery partition expiration to 90d minimum for compliance, (2) metric: emit a counter metric `sdlc.missing_kms_audit_total` when premerge check finds no decrypt row so we can alert on spikes.

sara_sec: i'll own the policy + PR for GH Actions to upload evidence-bundle and the pre-merge BigQuery check. rachel can own the BigQuery sink + IAM changes. tom can add the trace shim and signed bundle generator. i'll draft runbook text and link SEC-915. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
